ideas.pitch: An offline computer vision system running on edge NPUs to detect early-stage crop diseases and nutrient deficiencies in remote farming regions without reliable internet.
ideas.title: AgriGuard Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the hard engineering pattern by implementing localized, low-latency edge inference that directly addresses feasibility and real-world usefulness for agriculture.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent diagnostic pipeline for industrial IoT sensors that correlates telemetry anomalies with root-cause maintenance actions.
ideas.title: AeroInspect AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of combining agentic workflows with anomaly detection for industrial operations, appealing to judges looking for complex technical execution.

ideas.pitch: An assistive communication tool for healthcare settings that translates real-time sign language gestures into localized speech using custom pose-estimation models.
ideas.title: MediSign Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on a live, working demo of a socially impactful product, scoring high on originality and usefulness for assistive technology.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-secured smart grid monitoring node utilizing microcontroller analog signatures to detect physical meter tampering and grid leakage.
ideas.title: GridPulse Smart Meter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the unusual physical build pattern by integrating physical sensors and microcontrollers into a security dashboard, setting it apart from standard web apps.

ideas.pitch: A verifiable carbon footprint tracking application that uses zero-knowledge proofs to let manufacturers prove emission compliance without exposing proprietary supply chain data.
ideas.title: EcoTrace Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced cryptographic primitives (ZK proofs) to a major real-world sustainability challenge, demonstrating exceptionally high technical difficulty.
